rows.name: 历史关键词
rows.sql:
WITH posted AS (SELECT m.id AS mid, mt.weight AS evidence FROM message_terms mt JOIN messages m ON m.id=mt.message_id
      WHERE mt.term=($4::text[])[1]
      AND m.user_id=$1 AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM unnest($4::text[]) wanted(term) WHERE NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM message_terms other WHERE other.term=wanted.term AND other.message_id=m.id))),
      matching_concepts AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT k.id FROM concepts k WHERE (k.owner_user_id IS NULL OR k.owner_user_id=$1)
        AND (k.name ILIKE $3 ESCAPE '\' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM concept_aliases ca WHERE ca.concept_id=k.id AND ca.alias ILIKE $3 ESCAPE '\'))
      ),
      matched AS (
        SELECT CASE WHEN m.role='user' THEN m.id ELSE m.reply_to_id END AS qid, 3::real+least(posted.evidence,8)::real/100 AS score
        FROM posted JOIN messages m ON m.id=posted.mid
        JOIN conversations cv ON cv.id=m.conversation_id AND cv.user_id=m.user_id
        WHERE m.user_id=$1 AND (m.content ILIKE $3 ESCAPE '\' OR cv.title ILIKE $3 ESCAPE '\')
        
        UNION ALL
        SELECT CASE WHEN m.role='user' THEN m.id ELSE m.reply_to_id END, 1::real
        FROM message_concepts mc JOIN messages m ON m.id=mc.message_id
        JOIN matching_concepts k ON k.id=mc.concept_id
        WHERE m.user_id=$1 AND mc.status<>'rejected'
      ), cand AS (SELECT qid,max(score)+count(DISTINCT score)::real/4 AS score FROM matched GROUP BY qid), base AS (
  SELECT qm.id AS question_id, qm.conversation_id, qm.content AS question, qm.created_at,
         c.title, c.origin, cand.score AS relevance, am.id AS answer_id, am.content AS answer, am.status AS answer_status
  FROM cand JOIN messages qm ON qm.id = cand.qid
  JOIN conversations c ON c.id = qm.conversation_id AND c.user_id = qm.user_id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
     SELECT a.id, a.content, a.status FROM messages a
     WHERE a.reply_to_id = qm.id AND a.user_id = qm.user_id
     ORDER BY a.seq DESC LIMIT 1) am ON true
  WHERE qm.user_id = $1
    AND qm.role = 'user'
    AND c.archived_at IS NULL
)
SELECT b.*, to_char(b.created_at AT TIME ZONE $2, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS local_time, count(*) OVER () AS total
FROM base b
ORDER BY b.relevance DESC, b.created_at DESC, b.question_id DESC
LIMIT $5 OFFSET $6

Plans.Filter: (((owner_user_id IS NULL) OR (owner_user_id = '8fdec9b4-a0f5-4b94-a87d-3a9b23b8bff3'::uuid)) AND ((name ~~* '%索引%'::text) OR (hashed SubPlan 2)))

Group Key: (CASE WHEN (m.role = 'user'::text) THEN m.id ELSE m.reply_to_id END)

Sort Key: (CASE WHEN (m.role = 'user'::text) THEN m.id ELSE m.reply_to_id END)

Plans.Index Cond: (id = (CASE WHEN (m.role = 'user'::text) THEN m.id ELSE m.reply_to_id END))

rows.name: 日期范围
rows.sql:
WITH  base AS (
  SELECT qm.id AS question_id, qm.conversation_id, qm.content AS question, qm.created_at,
         c.title, c.origin, 0::real AS relevance, am.id AS answer_id, am.content AS answer, am.status AS answer_status
  FROM messages qm
  JOIN conversations c ON c.id = qm.conversation_id AND c.user_id = qm.user_id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
     SELECT a.id, a.content, a.status FROM messages a
     WHERE a.reply_to_id = qm.id AND a.user_id = qm.user_id
     ORDER BY a.seq DESC LIMIT 1) am ON true
  WHERE qm.user_id = $1
    AND qm.role = 'user'
    AND c.archived_at IS NULL
    AND qm.created_at >= ($3::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE $2
    AND qm.created_at < (($4::date + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE $2)
)
SELECT b.*, to_char(b.created_at AT TIME ZONE $2, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS local_time, count(*) OVER () AS total
FROM base b
ORDER BY b.relevance DESC, b.created_at DESC, b.question_id DESC
LIMIT $5 OFFSET $6

Plans.Index Cond: ((user_id = '8fdec9b4-a0f5-4b94-a87d-3a9b23b8bff3'::uuid) AND (created_at >= '2026-01-04 00:00:00+08'::timestamp with time zone) AND (created_at < '2026-01-08 00:00:00+08'::timestamp with time zone))

rows.name: 知识点
rows.sql:
WITH  base AS (
  SELECT qm.id AS question_id, qm.conversation_id, qm.content AS question, qm.created_at,
         c.title, c.origin, 0::real AS relevance, am.id AS answer_id, am.content AS answer, am.status AS answer_status
  FROM messages qm
  JOIN conversations c ON c.id = qm.conversation_id AND c.user_id = qm.user_id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
     SELECT a.id, a.content, a.status FROM messages a
     WHERE a.reply_to_id = qm.id AND a.user_id = qm.user_id
     ORDER BY a.seq DESC LIMIT 1) am ON true
  WHERE qm.user_id = $1
    AND qm.role = 'user'
    AND c.archived_at IS NULL
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM message_concepts mc
                         WHERE mc.message_id IN (qm.id, am.id) AND mc.status <> 'rejected'
                           AND mc.concept_id = ANY($3::uuid[]))
)
SELECT b.*, to_char(b.created_at AT TIME ZONE $2, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS local_time, count(*) OVER () AS total
FROM base b
ORDER BY b.relevance DESC, b.created_at DESC, b.question_id DESC
LIMIT $4 OFFSET $5
